rust_summary: line of sight between two entities (`native_has_line_of_sight`, `LivingEntity.hasLineOfSight`) and a COLLIDER block ray with no entity (`native_clear_between`, `Level.clip` missing) in the level being ticked.
doc_summary: `host.has_line_of_sight(from_entity, to_entity)` is `LivingEntity.hasLineOfSight`: the eyes of the first entity to the eyes of the second, against COLLIDER block shapes and no fluids, within 128 blocks and in one level; `host.clear_between(dimension, from, to)` is the same COLLIDER ray between two points, true when it meets no collider. Both answer for the level being ticked on a server. Bundles need "hooks": @API:line_of_sight@.
